business_summary.text: Religare Enterprises is a holding company with two segments: Care Health Insurance, a stand-alone health insurer, and financial services spanning Religare Broking, Religare Finvest (MSME lending) and Religare Housing Finance.

call_points.text: Care targets a 100% combined ratio in two years, reiterating the commitment from the last call.
Care will not give full-year growth guidance; it intends to beat the market.
Care raised ₹150 Cr equity in Q1 and ₹200 Cr sub-debt in August 2026.
RBI declined the demerger application without giving a reason; management is engaging with the regulator.
The tentative Q1FY28 demerger deadline will likely slip, management conceded.
Care's gross opex ratio was 31.2%, improving 100 bps YoY.
Religare Finvest's written-off pool is ₹350-400 Cr; recoveries are expected to taper as the legacy book dwindles.
